ShortDescription.Value: Advanced Transit Operations (ATO) is a public transit dispatch mod for Cities: Skylines II.

Publish.LongDescription:
Advanced Transit Operations (ATO) is a public transit dispatch mod for Cities: Skylines II.
The current version supports Train, Subway, Tram, and Bus. Supported languages: English, Simplified Chinese, and Japanese.
## What's New in v0.5.2
This version redesigns the Departure Control page. It now shows line ridership and all-day onboard load, so you can adjust trips by time period with actual passenger flow in view. Each trip in the trip list links directly to its run record, making it easier to check how it actually ran. Transport mode selection has moved to the sidebar, so switching no longer requires returning to the Overview page.
This update comes a month after the previous version, mainly because most of that time went into rewriting core modules such as save loading and dispatch. As features grew, the existing code became increasingly difficult to maintain and fix, and this rewrite is meant to keep the project maintainable in the long run. After the rewrite, the mod now takes control of vehicles immediately after loading a save, and previously reported issues such as duplicate departures and late vehicles unloading passengers and returning to the depot have also been fixed.
This update also includes a number of UI refinements.
## Core Gameplay
### Build Timetables That Fit Your Service
Control only origin departures when that is all you need, or create a full timetable with scheduled departure times at intermediate stops. Different services can use different schedules for peak, off-peak, and final operations, giving you precise control without requiring a full timetable for every line.
### Signal Priority
ATO begins preparing green lights while vehicles are still hundreds of meters away. It checks up to 3 intersections within 320 meters ahead and uses the vanilla game's mechanisms to request the required green phases in advance, helping buses and trams pass through multiple intersections with fewer stops. In testing, trams on semi-exclusive right-of-way can achieve green lights for almost the entire journey. For best results, enable signal priority only on a few key lines and use dedicated lanes.
### Run Passing Operations
Configure Rapid and Local lines along the same corridor, then choose which stations can be used for passing operations. When a rapid train catches up with a local train ahead, ATO will have the local train wait at a Bypass Station for the rapid train to pass.
### Create Broadcasts for Your City
Import your own audio files and create automatically triggered broadcasts for vehicles and platforms. Use dynamic station names and multilingual audio to create a distinctive announcement system for your city.
### Observe Real Passenger Flow
ATO records actual boardings, alightings, section loads, and completed OD data, helping you adjust service frequency, Rapid and Local stopping patterns, and line layouts based on actual operating results.
## Gameplay Guide
For the complete gameplay guide, interface instructions, recommended line layouts, detailed configuration steps, and frequently asked questions, please visit GitHub:
GitHub Gameplay Guide: https://github.com/huasyl/AdvancedTransitOperations/blob/main/docs/player-guide.en-US.md
ATO has two in-game interfaces. Left-click the mod button in the upper-right corner to open the Workbench panel, and right-click it to open the Selection panel.
## Before You Start
After the first load or a line structure change, ATO needs to collect running data again, and dispatch may take several in-game hours to stabilize.
Lines built with bidirectional single-track railway sections are currently not supported, but depot access tracks and junction areas in front of stations are not affected.
## Compatibility & Save Safety
This mod does not use Harmony.
- **Xtended Transport Manager (XTM):** Full compatibility has been implemented. After using Set first stop, ATO will collect updated running data for the line, and dispatch may take some time to stabilize again.
- **Traffic Tool Essentials:** Its Depot Zone conflicts with ATO’s Depot Selection feature because both affect depot assignment. Please enable only one of these two features. Other features can coexist. At intersections where Green Wave is enabled, ATO’s Signal Priority will not take effect.
- **FastBoarding:** Can coexist, but using rail fast boarding or late-passenger skipping on rail lines controlled by ATO is not recommended.
- **Realistic Trips:** Compatible and can be used together with ATO.
- **All Aboard!:** Incompatible. All Aboard! replaces the vanilla public transport vehicle systems that ATO relies on.
Other mods that automatically adjust vehicle count, departure intervals, boarding speed, the game’s time flow, or the public transport vehicle lifecycle may also cause conflicts. Please refer to GitHub for complete compatibility details.
ATO only stores its own data and does not permanently modify vanilla assets. Disabling or removing it should not damage saves or leave persistent simulation issues, and public transport will return to vanilla behavior. ATO is still in beta, so backing up important saves is recommended. Development, testing, validation, and release decisions remain under developer control, with AI tools used only to assist parts of the workflow.
If you encounter an issue, or have any feedback or suggestions, you are welcome to report it on the forum or GitHub: GitHub: https://github.com/huasyl/AdvancedTransitOperations
If you find ATO fun or helpful for operating your public transport network, please consider giving the mod a like. Thank you for playing and supporting ATO!
**———————— 中文版 / CHINESE VERSION ————————**
Advanced Transit Operations（ATO）是面向《城市：天际线 2》公共交通运营的调度 Mod。
当前支持火车、地铁、有轨电车和公交。支持语言：英语、简体中文、日语。
## v0.5.2 更新内容
本版本重新设计了发车控制页。页面加入了线路客流与全天在车人数，便于对照实际客流，按时段直观地调整班次。班次列表中的每个班次均可直接跳转至对应的运行记录，方便查阅实际运行情况。交通方式选择移至侧栏，切换时无需返回总览页。
本次更新与上一版本间隔一个月，主要原因是这段时间集中重写了读档接管、调度等底层模块。随着功能不断增加，原有代码的维护和问题修复愈发困难，此次重写意在保证项目能够长期稳定地维护。重写后，读档时模组会立即接管车辆，此前反馈的重复发车、晚点车辆被清客回库等问题也已一并修复。
此外，本次更新还包含若干界面细节优化。
## 核心玩法
### 按需设置运行时刻
如果只需要控制始发站发车，可以仅设置始发时间；也可以进一步创建完整时刻表，为中途站设置计划发车时间。不同班次可分别使用高峰、平峰和末班时段的运行计划，在提供更精细控制的同时，也无需为每条线路都设置完整时刻表。
### 信号优先
车辆仍在数百米外时，ATO 就会开始为前方路口准备绿灯。系统会检查车辆前方 320 米范围内最多 3 个路口，并利用原版机制提前申请对应相位的绿灯，让公交和有轨电车能够连续通过多个路口，尽量减少停车等灯。经测试，对于采用半独立路权的有轨电车几乎可以实现全程绿灯通行。建议仅在部分线路上启用信号优先，并配合专用道使用，以获得最佳效果。
### 开行快车、慢车与越行服务
为同一走廊设置快线、普通线和待避站。当快车追上前方慢车时，ATO 会让慢车在待避站等待快车通过。
### 制作属于自己城市的广播
导入自己的音频，为车辆和站台设置自动触发的广播，并通过动态站名和多语言音频制作具有城市特色的报站系统。
### 观测真实客流
ATO 会记录实际乘降、区间载客量和已完成 OD 数据，帮助您根据真实运营结果调整班次、快慢车停站方案和线路结构。
## 游玩指引
完整游玩指引、界面说明、线路搭建方式、详细配置方法及常见问题请参阅 GitHub：
GitHub 游玩指引：https://github.com/huasyl/AdvancedTransitOperations/blob/main/docs/player-guide.zh-CN.md
ATO 有两个界面。左键单击游戏右上角的 Mod 按钮打开工作台面板，右键单击打开选择面板。
## 使用前须知
第一次载入或线路结构发生变化后，ATO 需要重新收集运行数据，调度可能需要几个游戏小时逐步稳定。
目前不支持使用单线双向铁路区间构建的线路，但出入库线和站前分岔区域不受此限制。
## 兼容性与存档安全
本 Mod 未使用 Harmony。
- **Xtended Transport Manager（XTM）：** 已实现全面兼容。使用“设置首站”后，ATO 会重新观测线路运行数据，调度可能需要一点时间重新稳定。
- **Traffic Tool Essentials：** 其 Depot Zone 功能与 ATO 的车库选择功能会同时影响车库分配，建议只启用其中一个；其他功能可以共存。在启用绿波的路口，ATO 的信号优先功能不会生效。
- **FastBoarding：** 可以共存，但不建议在 ATO 接管的轨道线路上启用轨道快速上客或跳过迟到乘客。
- **Realistic Trips：** 已实现兼容，可以共同使用。
- **All Aboard!：** 不兼容。该 Mod 会替换 ATO 所依赖的原版公共交通车辆运行系统。
自动调整车辆数、发车间隔、上客速度、游戏时间流速或车辆运行流程的其他 Mod 也可能产生冲突。完整兼容说明请参阅 GitHub。
ATO 只向存档写入自身的配置和运行数据，不会永久修改原版线路、车站或车辆资产。关闭或移除后，不应损坏存档或留下持续性的模拟异常，公共交通将恢复按照游戏自身逻辑运行。ATO 目前仍处于 Beta 阶段，因此重要存档仍建议提前备份。模组的开发、测试、验证和版本发布均由开发者主导和把控，AI 工具仅用于辅助部分开发流程。
如果您遇到问题，或有任何意见和建议，欢迎通过论坛或 GitHub 反馈： GitHub：https://github.com/huasyl/AdvancedTransitOperations
如果您觉得 ATO 好玩，或者它对您的公共交通运营有所帮助，欢迎为本 Mod 点个赞。感谢您的游玩与支持！
Publish.ChangeLog:
## New Features
- Redesigned Departure Control page. Switch transport modes and lines directly from the sidebar. On a single line, you can plan trips against the line's ridership and all-day onboard load, and adjust trip counts by time period. - The trip list now shows how each trip actually ran, such as on time, early, late or missed. Click to jump to its record on the Timetable page. - Added a "Verbose logging" option to the General tab of the mod settings for troubleshooting.
## Improvements
- After loading a save, the mod now takes control of vehicles on the first simulation frame. Previously there was a gap of about 2 in-game minutes with no dispatch control. - Improved some UI details. Next-day times are now marked with a "+1" superscript, and they are no longer cut off in records on the Timetable page. Long station names now wrap in the vehicle info panel. Added open and close animations to the workbench. - Added tooltips explaining some features.
## Performance
- Slightly improved performance.
## Bug Fixes
- Fixed an issue where a late vehicle could be treated as waiting almost a full day for its trip, then unload passengers and return to the depot. - Fixed an issue where a vehicle could occasionally depart twice, with the following vehicle taking the same trip. - Fixed an issue where an idle vehicle already at the origin stop would not take a trip that was waiting for a vehicle leaving the depot. - Fixed an issue where vehicles leaving the depot could return to the depot immediately if they arrived at the origin stop slightly earlier than expected. - Fixed an issue where depot travel time estimates stayed too short, causing new vehicles to miss their trips. This was more likely when pausing right after loading a save. - Fixed an issue where, after a vehicle switched lines or left its line, the line could dispatch extra vehicles or assign its trips to vehicles on other lines.
